  "description": "ThingsGateway is an open-source industrial IoT edge gateway built on .NET 8/10. It provides high-performance data acquisition from various industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC, S7, MQTT), edge processing via C# scripts and rule engines, and reliable data forwarding to backends (MQTT, Web API, Kafka, DB). It features a plugin architecture, local buffering for intermittent connectivity, and a web-based management interface.",
